en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an aerial or elevated view of a modernist multi‑storey hotel complex on a curved mountain road surrounded by forest. The building has long balconies, a flat roof, and a terrace with rows of deck chairs. At the bottom of the image, handwritten text identifies the place. The reverse side is divided for message and address, written in blue ink in Hungarian, with a Hungarian postage stamp and postmark.
